next.reason: 1985: in an abbreviated combined relation condition, 'If the word immediately following NOT is GREATER, >, LESS, <, EQUAL, =, then the NOT participates as part of the relational operator'. §2023:8.8.4.12.2's format lets NOT, a simple-relational-operator or an extended-relational-operator precede object-1 ('simple-relational-operator and extended-relational-operator are described in 8.7.5, Relational operators'), and §2023:8.7.5.1 Format 2 (extended-relational-operator) holds exactly IS NOT GREATER THAN, NOT >, NOT LESS THAN, NOT <, NOT EQUAL TO, NOT =; §2023:8.8.4.12.4 GR1's note: NOT 'could be as a part of an extended-relational-operator', with 1985's own examples. Every case this rule covers parses the same; the 'otherwise' branch (incl. NOT NOT) is 1985-GR-VI.6.3.3-L2.2.
